analysis.lap_rule: fastest lap with validated speed + position telemetry
analysis.note: Spatial split derived from GPS speed; indicative, not timing-grade.
analysis.scale_note: Each lap is scaled from its pre-scale GPS integral to its official lap time; per-driver factor is persisted.
analysis.dt_null_rule: null dt bins are excluded from sums; sum(dt) < lap_time when nulls exist

average_rule.label: Average of clean laps
average_rule.lap_rule: valid sectors, not pit-out, within 110% of driver median
average_rule.note: Official lap and sector means; spatial profile is the mean of each lap normalised to its own official time.
